;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2018 bombing of Damascus and Homs]]
***The [[United States]], [[France]], and the [[United Kingdom]] target chemical weapon sites and other [[Syrian Arab Army|Syrian military]] sites with missile strikes on early Saturday morning [[Syria]]n time ([[Eastern European Time|EET]]), in response to the [[Douma chemical attack]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/us-launches-missile-strikes-in-syria/2018/04/13/c68e89d0-3f4a-11e8-974f-aacd97698cef_story.html?noredirect=on (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-43762251 (BBC)] 
***[[Russia]] calls for an emergency meeting of the [[United Nations Security Council]] as it considers supplying [[S-300 missile system]]s to Syria. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-putin/russia-calls-for-un-meeting-on-syria-mulls-supplies-of-s-300-systems-idUSKBN1HL0GV (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**An explosion near the [[Israel–Gaza border]] fence kills at least four [[Palestinian people|Palestinians]]. [[Hamas]] says terrorists from [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad]] were killed. Locals claim the explosion was from the [[Israeli Defence Forces]] shelling Hamas. Israel denies any involvement. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-4-palestinians-reported-killed-in-explosion-in-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**The [[Palestinian Authority]] says an [[Egypt]]ian delegation presently visiting [[Gaza City]] has asked [[Hamas]] to call off the [[Great March of Return]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/pa-official-egypt-asked-hamas-to-stop-gaza-protests/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Israel]]i forces shoot and wound a Palestinian near [[Khan Younis]]. Local medical personnel report he has a bullet lodged in his head. [http://english.wafa.ps/page.aspx?id=DHJF65a97286288154aDHJF65 (wafa)]
**[[Palestine Liberation Organization]] Executive Committee Member [[Hanan Ashrawi]] calls for international intervention to "protect Palestinians". [http://english.wafa.ps/page.aspx?id=v2HGrpa97283432895av2HGrp (wafa)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**The [[Taliban]] destroy an [[Transmission tower|electricity pylon]] in Doshe, [[Baghlan]], [[Afghanistan]], overnight. The pylon carries imported power from [[Tajikistan]] and [[Uzbekistan]], and its destruction causes widespread blackouts across several provinces and in capital [[Kabul]]. [https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/taliban-destroy-pylon-leaving-kabul-dark (Tolo News)]
*An explosion strikes a major weapons depot linked to [[Hezbollah]] and [[Iran]] in [[Mount Azzan]], near [[Aleppo]], [[Syria]]. Local media and [[Sky News]] reports an unidentified jet attacked the site, possibly as part of Western coalition airstrikes in the region, but ''[[al-Mayadeen]]'' denies any airstrike happened and said controlled explosions were carried out at the site yesterday. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/large-scale-explosion-reported-at-iranian-base-in-syria/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Terrorism in Egypt]]
**The [[Egypt]]ian military says 14 terrorists attacked a [[Sinai (peninsula)|Sinai]] military base today, with four of them blowing themselves up and killing eight soldiers. [https://www.egypttoday.com/Article/1/47748/Terror-attack-on-Army-Camp-in-Sinai-foiled-Army-Spox (Egypt Today)]
*[[Yemen]] accuses [[Iran]] of arming [[Houthi]] rebels with drones in violation of [[United Nations]] sanctions to allow the militants to launch attacks on [[Saudi Arabia]]. Iran supports the Houthis but denies arming them. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2018/Apr-14/445291-yemen-govt-accuses-iran-of-arming-houthis-with-drones.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
*A civilian vehicle hits an unexploded [[landmine]] in [[Arsal]], [[Lebanon]]. Three occupants die. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2018/Apr-14/445273-three-dead-in-arsal-landmine-explosion.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*A storm blasts central US with heavy snow, winds, and hail, forcing flight cancellations, creating treacherous road conditions and killing at least three people. [http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/storm-system-spawns-tornado-arkansas-blizzards-plains-54465291 (ABC News)]
*The [[US Navy]] concludes its investigation into the October crash of a [[T-45C Goshawk]] military training jet in [[Tennessee]]  that killed both on board, concluding pilot error caused the accident. [https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-navy/2018/04/14/navy-says-pilot-error-caused-last-years-training-jet-crash/ (Navy Times)]
;Law and crime
*The [[Court of Cassation]] in [[Egypt]] upholds life sentences for three [[Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt|Muslim Brotherhood]] leaders including [[Mohamed Badie]] and five-year terms for fourteen others. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2018/Apr-14/445286-egypt-court-upholds-life-sentence-against-brotherhood-leader.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
*[[Terrorism in Iraq]]
**[[ISIL|The Islamic State]] ambushes a member of [[al-Hashd al-Shaabi]] on Neft Khana road, near [[Khanqeen]], northeast of [[Baquba]], [[Iraq]]. The militants execute him. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/paramilitary-personnel-slaughtered-in-ambush-by-islamic-state-northeast-of-baquba/ (Iraqi News)]
;Politics and elections
*[[UK Independence Party leadership election, 2018]]
**[[Gerard Batten]] is elected unopposed as the leader of the [[UK Independence Party]], having been interim leader of the party since previous leader [[Henry Bolton (British politician)|Henry Bolton]] was overthrown in a vote of no confidence in February. [https://news.sky.com/story/ukip-confirms-gerard-batten-as-new-leader-11331630 (Sky News)]
